name: optcatalog_find_entry_by_id
description: OptCatalog::FindEntryById scans the loaded catalog table for a keyed entry with a matching ordinal id.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native OptCatalog lookup tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4ae450 validates reading g_OptCatalog_EntryCount and g_OptCatalog_EntryTable, returning null for empty tables, skipping entries whose keyName is null, returning the matching ordinalIndex entry, and returning null on miss.
The native OptCatalog smoke verifies matching lookup, null-key skipping, missing-id null return, and empty-table null return.
